en.headline: 2 commits, 1 issue opened, 1 discussion comment
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` made **2 own commits** across two repositories, plus 3 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, one own commit tagged the release as `v1.15.5` (`chore(release): v1.15.5`). In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, one own commit fixed daily-report commit attribution to support aliases and non-GitHub-account email addresses (`fix(daily): 提交归属支持别名，兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交`); the same repo also saw 3 automated commits from `github-actions[bot]`. No pull requests or reviews were recorded. One issue was opened: `openchamber/openchamber` #4920, titled "[Bug] Context panel breakdown bar divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input, so 其他 is always 0%", which remains open. The user also joined an existing discussion, `openchamber/openchamber` #4821 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" (Ideas, 1 comment), by commenting rather than starting it. No releases, stars, or replies were recorded, and no section hit its collection cap.

zh.headline: 2 次提交、1 个新 issue、1 条讨论回复
zh.summary: 2026-10-15，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库中完成 **2 次本人提交**，另有 3 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，1 次本人提交将版本标记为 `v1.15.5`（`chore(release): v1.15.5`）。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，1 次本人提交修复了日报提交归属逻辑，使其支持别名并兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交（`fix(daily): 提交归属支持别名，兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交`）；同一仓库还有 3 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。当日没有 PR 或 review 记录。新开 1 个 issue：`openchamber/openchamber` #4920，标题为 "[Bug] Context panel breakdown bar divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input, so 其他 is always 0%"，目前仍处于 open 状态。此外，用户在已有讨论 `openchamber/openchamber` #4821 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel"（Ideas，1 条评论）中进行了评论，而非发起新讨论。当日没有 release、star 或回复记录，且没有任何分区触及采集上限。
